units.text: INT. BARBARA - CONTINUOUS
I do not: all the poet in me recoils from being a good man. But there are things in me that I must reckon with: pity--
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Pity! The scavenger of misery.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: Well, love.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: I know. You love the needy and the outcast: you love the oppressed races, the negro, the Indian ryot, the Pole, the Irishman. Do you love the Japanese? Do you love the Germans? Do you love the English?
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: No. Every true Englishman detests the English. We are the wickedest nation on earth; and our success is a moral horror.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: That is what comes of your gospel of love, is it?
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: May I not love even my father-in-law?
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Who wants your love, man? By what right do you take the liberty of offering it to me? I will have your due heed and respect, or I will kill you. But your love! Damn your impertinence!
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: CUSINS [grinning] I may not be able to control my affections, Mac.
You are fencing, Euripides. You are weakening: your grip is slipping. Come! try your last weapon. Pity and love have broken in your hand: forgiveness is still left.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: No: forgiveness is a beggar's refuge. I am with you there: we must pay our debts.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Well said. Come! you will suit me. Remember the words of Plato.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: CUSINS [starting] Plato!
You dare quote Plato to me!
Plato says, my friend, that society cannot be saved until either the Professors of Greek take to making gunpowder, or else the makers of gunpowder become Professors of Greek.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: Oh, tempter, cunning tempter!
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Come! choose, man, choose.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: But perhaps Barbara will not marry me if I make the wrong choice.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Perhaps not.
units.name: BARBARA

units.text: CUSINS [desperately perplexed] You hear--
Father: do you love nobody?
units.name: BARBARA

units.text: I love my best friend.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: And who is that, pray?
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: My bravest enemy. That is the man who keeps me up to the mark.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: You know, the creature is really a sort of poet in his way. Suppose he is a great man, after all!
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Suppose you stop talking and make up your mind, my young friend.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: But you are driving me against my nature. I hate war.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Hatred is the coward's revenge for being intimidated. Dare you make war on war? Here are the means: my friend Mr Lomax is sitting on them.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: LOMAX [springing up] Oh I say!
You don't mean that this thing is loaded, do you?
My ownest: come off it.
SARAH [sitting placidly on the shell] If I am to be blown up, the more thoroughly it is done the better.
Don't fuss, Cholly.
LOMAX [to Undershaft, strongly remonstrant] Your own daughter, you know.
So I see.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: To Cusins.
Well, my friend, may we expect you here at six tomorrow morning?
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: CUSINS [firmly] Not on any account.
I will see the whole establishment blown up with its own dynamite before I will get up at five.
My hours are healthy, rational hours eleven to five.
Come when you please: before a week you will come at six and stay until I turn you out for the sake of your health.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: Calling.
Bilton!
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: He turns to Lady Britomart, who rises.
My dear: let us leave these two young people to themselves for a moment.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: Bilton comes from the shed.
I am going to take you through the gun cotton shed.
units.name: UNDERSHAFT

units.text: BILTON [barring the way] You can't take anything explosive in here, Sir.
What do you mean? Are you alluding to me?
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: BILTON [unmoved] No, ma'am.
Mr Undershaft has the other gentleman's matches in his pocket.
LADY BRITOMART [abruptly] Oh!
I beg your pardon. [She goes into the shed].
